faq.question: How long does SEO take to work?
faq.answer: Technical fixes can help within weeks, but rankings usually build over a few months as Google re-crawls your site.

faq.question: Can you do SEO on my existing website?
faq.answer: Yes. I audit your current site, fix technical issues and improve titles, structure and speed.

faq.question: Which SEO plugin do you use?
faq.answer: Usually SEOPress, but I also work with Yoast and Rank Math if your site already uses them.

faq.question: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
faq.answer: No honest developer can guarantee rankings, but I fix what holds your site back and set it up to compete.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: It depends on your site’s size and needs. Tell me about your website and I’ll send a clear quote.
